publisher.name: Ravish House
publisher.about: Ravish House publishes love stories that no one asked for and everyone secretly wants. Our authors chase passion into the strangest corners of human life — down to crush depth, out to the edge of the caldera, deep into the compost heap. Every heart in our catalog beats against a backdrop no other publisher would dare.

series.title: Love by the Numbers
series.author: Prudence Everdeath
series.authorBio: Prudence Everdeath, FSA, spent nineteen years pricing catastrophe reinsurance before discovering that the greatest risk of all is the human heart. She lives in Hartford with two cats, both fully indemnified.
series.blurb: In the high-stakes world of long-term liability, two actuaries discover that some probabilities are worth betting your whole life on.

books.title: Present Value
books.description: Diana Marchetti prices catastrophe risk at Gibraltar Mutual and has never mis-forecast a death in her life. Then the firm poaches Julian Thorne, a rival actuary brought in to audit her longevity models, and assigns her to build his personal mortality curve as a "team-building exercise." Her spreadsheet nails his life expectancy to the fiscal quarter — but reviewing his lifestyle assumptions cell by cell sends the discount rate of her own heart into freefall. Across three white-knuckle quarterly board meetings, with a nine-figure longevity swap and both their careers riding on her numbers, Diana must decide whether a love with no historical precedent is a risk worth underwriting. Slow-burn, spreadsheet-soaked, and dangerously precise.

books.title: Confidence Interval
books.description: Senior analyst Marcus Vane was ninety-five percent certain he would never love again; his grief had a standard deviation and a tidy little error bar. Then Priya Ramaswamy joins the reserving team as the outlier who breaks every model he has ever trusted — a woman whose behavior refuses to fall inside any interval he can construct. When the two are forced to co-author a doomed regulatory filing under a brutal deadline, their nightly data reconciliations turn into something no p-value can explain. But Priya is hiding a result that could invalidate his life's work, and Marcus must choose between statistical significance and the one variable he never controlled for. A tale of two analysts, one rejected null hypothesis, and a correlation that finally, terrifyingly, implies causation.

books.title: The Deductible
books.description: There are some losses you simply cannot insure against — like the way rival actuary Nathaniel Crole murmurs "mortality table" across the coverage-review room. Claims specialist Fiona Beck has spent a decade building an emotional policy with a deductible so high nothing can trigger a payout. Then a catastrophic office reorganization traps her and Nathaniel on the same doomed product line, pricing coverage no one believes in, working late beneath flickering fluorescents and mounting, unresolved tension. As a surprise audit closes in and their assumptions start to align a little too perfectly, Fiona learns that the premiums on a guarded heart come due whether you file a claim or not. A steamy, meticulous office romance in full compliance with all applicable regulations.

books.title: Terminal Dividend
books.description: The series finale. Thirty years after they first clashed over a discount-rate assumption, Diana and Julian are the graying co-chairs of the same pension fund — and the fund is finally maturing, its last obligations coming due just as their own careers wind toward a terminal dividend. When a forgotten actuarial error from their very first collaboration resurfaces, threatening to unravel three decades of carefully accrued life, the two must reopen the ledger on everything they were too cautious to say. A sweeping, tissue-demanding capstone about compounding love, deferred gratification, and the one payout that was always guaranteed. Bring a financial calculator and a full box of Kleenex.

series.title: Fathoms of the Heart
series.author: Marina Deeps
series.authorBio: Marina Deeps served eleven years aboard nuclear submarines and now writes from a windowless room by choice. She insists it helps her concentrate.
series.blurb: Two hundred meters down, in a steel tube where no one can hear you sigh, the pressure to fall in love becomes unbearable.

books.title: Silent Running
books.description: Rule one of the silent service: no sudden movements. Rule two, unwritten but iron: do not fall for the sonar officer. Commander Reyes Hale, forty days into a classified patrol beneath the Arctic ice, is about to break both. When Lieutenant Sana Okafor detects an acoustic signature that should not exist — something following them through the black — the boat goes to ultra-quiet, and the two are pressed together in the cramped sonar shack for hours at a stretch, forbidden even to whisper. Every heartbeat feels loud enough to give away their position. As the mystery contact shadows them toward an international incident, Hale must decide whether the greatest threat to his command is outside the hull or inside his own headset. A slow, silent, unbearable burn.

books.title: Crush Depth
books.description: The deeper the USS Perdita dives, the harder Chief Engineer Dominic Vasquez's heart pounds — and it has nothing to do with the pressure gauge. When a reactor casualty forces the boat below its tested limits, the hull groaning like a living thing, the only person calm enough to help him nurse the failing plant is the new medical officer, Dr. Elena Marsh — the woman he swore he would never speak to again after their disastrous shore leave in Guam. Trapped together in a flooding engine room with the depth needle sliding past crush depth, old wounds and undeniable want rise to the surface under a pressure neither can withstand. A second-chance romance set at the absolute limit of human endurance, where the only thing more dangerous than the sea is what they left unsaid.

books.title: Periscope Up
books.description: After six months submerged and running dark, Executive Officer Nadia Petrov surfaces expecting nothing but sunlight and a mountain of paperwork — and finds the one thing she cannot leave below decks: Torpedoman Gabriel Reyes, who spent the entire patrol quietly, wordlessly loving her from two compartments away. Now that they have made port, all the pressure that kept them apart is gone, and neither knows how to exist in open air with actual room to breathe. When a sudden recall order threatens to send the boat back under before they can name what six months of silence built, Nadia must choose between the deep that raised her and the man who waited through all of it. A tender, sun-flooded reunion novel with authentic ballast.

series.title: The Rind & the Reckless
series.author: Colby Jack Sterling
series.authorBio: Colby Jack Sterling is a three-time regional affineur of the year and a lifelong believer that the way to anyone's heart is a properly aged Gruyère.
series.blurb: In the cutthroat world of artisanal cheese competition, two rival makers discover that love, like a good Camembert, cannot be rushed.

books.title: The Washed Rind
books.description: Wilhelmina "Willa" Brandt's Époisses was disqualified from the National Curd Championships for being, in the head judge's trembling words, "too seductive to evaluate objectively." Her nemesis, three-time champion Beau Castellano, has never lost with his flawless raw-milk cheddar, and never lets her forget it. When the two are drawn as forced partners for the Championship's brutal new team round — one washed rind, one hard cheese, one shared aging cave — the funk turns personal. Her methods are chaos and instinct; his are discipline and spreadsheets, and the heat rising between the racks threatens to spoil an entire season's make. As sabotage rumors ripple through the co-op, they discover the fiercest competition is the one for each other's guarded heart. Pungent, funny, and impossible to rush.

books.title: Aged to Perfection
books.description: Eighteen months in the cave changes a cheese — and, it turns out, a man. When disgraced affineur Silas Rourke returns to Cutter's Bluff after vanishing at the height of his career, the only person who will rent him aging space is Margaret Doyle, the woman he left standing at a regional competition a lifetime ago. She has built a quiet empire of alpine tommes in his absence; he has come back with a secret recipe and a body of regret he cannot seem to age out of. Forced to share her cave through one long, humid summer, turning wheels side by side in the dark, they confront the culture they started and abandoned. A second-chance romance with deep notes of hay, hazelnut, and heartbreak, and a finish that lasts.

books.title: Say Cheese
books.description: The commission of a lifetime — a seven-tier wedding "cake" built entirely from cheese for a billionaire's vineyard wedding — forces bitter rivals Colette Fromage and Duncan Reyes into the same suffocatingly small aging room for six sweltering weeks. She is a delicate bloomy-rind purist; he builds bold, structural clothbound monsters, and the only way to hit the impossible deadline is to blend their opposing styles into something neither has ever attempted. As the temperature climbs and the humidity fogs their goggles, things get warm, then funky, then undeniable. But the bride's mother demands the whole tower remade three days out, and a single collapse — of the cheese or their resolve — could ruin them both. Warm, gooey, and gloriously over the top.

books.title: Reserve
books.description: The finale. Willa and Beau, partners now in life and in the make, stake everything on a single experimental wheel — a blended reserve that should not work, aged in secret for two years, entered against every titan in the industry at the last National Championship either intends to attend. As the judges' knives hover over their life's work, every rival, grudge, and stolen recipe from four books comes home to roost. When the gold is finally called, two rivals-turned-soulmates admit at last what everyone at the co-op knew from the very first stinking wheel. A rich, deeply satisfying capstone with a finish that lingers on the palate for days.

books.title: The Whey Home
books.description: A holiday novella. Snowed in at the creamery on Christmas Eve when a freak blizzard buries the mountain roads, apprentice cheesemaker Junie Alcott and gruff master affineur Tobias Frost have nothing to keep them warm but a single wheel of blue-veined Stilton, a failing woodstove, and a lifetime of experience between them. As the drifts climb past the windows and the night's make must be tended by hand or lost entirely, two strangers thrown together by circumstance discover that the warmest thing in any cave is company. A cozy, snow-globe-perfect stocking stuffer of a romance, best served at room temperature.

series.title: Below Zero, Above Reason
series.author: Dr. Ptarmigan Frost
series.authorBio: Dr. Ptarmigan Frost overwintered at McMurdo four times before deciding the only thing colder than the continent was her ex. She writes to stay warm.
series.blurb: Six months of darkness. Fourteen scientists. One thermostat war that becomes something much, much hotter.

books.title: The Long Night
books.description: When the sun sets over Erebus Station for the last time before winter — six months of unbroken darkness ahead — the fragile truce between glaciologist Dr. Wren Halvorsen and the station's perpetually furious HVAC engineer, Cal Mackey, finally cracks. She needs the labs held at a precise minus-two for her ice cores; he needs to keep fourteen humans from freezing to death, and the thermostat becomes a battlefield with real casualties. But as the dark closes in and isolation does its strange, slow work, their war over degrees Celsius thaws into the only heat source that matters at the bottom of the world. When a generator fails at the coldest hour of the coldest night, they will have to trust each other with far more than the temperature. Claustrophobic, crackling, and warm against all reason.

books.title: Core Sample
books.description: Two miles beneath the ice lies a lake sealed off for a million years — and the secrets in that ancient water are nothing next to the ones kept by Dr. Anton Reyes in the neighboring Quonset hut. Paleoclimatologist Mira Okonkwo has come to Vostok Deep to drill the oldest ice on Earth, and she needs Anton's borehole expertise, even though the last time they worked together he published her data under his own name. Forced into a single cramped drill tent for the polar winter, extracting the past one frozen layer at a time, the two thaw old betrayals and drill straight down into something raw and undeniable. When the core reveals a result that could end both their careers, they must decide what is truly worth preserving. A romance recovered from the deep past.

books.title: Windchill
books.description: The finale. After the longest winter of her life, glaciologist Wren hears the drone of the first resupply plane in eight months — the sound of the outside world coming to take her home. But going home means leaving Cal, the cantankerous engineer who kept her warm at minus sixty and became the one fixed point in six months of dark. With the plane fueling on the ice runway and a career-making position waiting on the mainland, Wren has one short, brutal window to choose between the life she built before the ice and the one she never planned for on it. A sweeping, windswept conclusion about what you will brave to stay somewhere impossible, with someone impossible.

series.title: Leave No Trace
series.author: Fern Compostella
series.authorBio: Fern Compostella has not produced a bag of landfill waste since 2009. She composts her own first drafts and knits her author photos from ethically shorn alpaca. She would prefer you read this bio and then forget it, to save the electrons.
series.blurb: Two militant zero-wasters, one shared compost heap, and a carbon footprint so small it can barely hold the weight of what they feel.

books.title: Reduce
books.description: Prunella Wells had whittled her entire existence down to a single mason jar of annual landfill trash — a life so frictionless it barely disturbed the air. Then Idris Kane moved into the duplex next door with a cargo bike, a worm bin the size of a bathtub, and a smile she absolutely could not recycle away. At first it is war: dueling compost piles, passive-aggressive notes on unbleached paper, a bitter contest over who can generate less. But when the city moves to bulldoze their shared community garden for a parking structure, the two zero-waste zealots must combine forces, and Prunella discovers that the one thing she can never reduce is how much space he takes up in her carefully minimized heart. Earnest, absurd, and lovingly low-impact.

books.title: Reuse
books.description: An old flame, refurbished. When her college sweetheart Theo Marsh turns up volunteering at the neighborhood repair café — the same Theo who broke her heart and, unforgivably, once threw a perfectly good toaster in the trash — Marisol Vega intends to fix appliances and absolutely nothing else. But a decade has reupholstered them both, and the long evenings spent resoldering strangers' lamps and darning strangers' socks slowly mend something between them neither believed was salvageable. As the café faces closure and a buried secret from their past resurfaces, Marisol must decide whether some hearts, like some hand-cranked blenders, are simply too good to throw out. A tender, sawdust-scented second-chance romance about the radical act of refusing to give up.

books.title: Recycle
books.description: The finale. At the cutthroat Regional Zero-Waste Championship — yes, it is a real event, and yes, it is brutal — reigning rivals-turned-partners Prunella and Idris compete as a team for the first time, chasing a title that could save their beloved community garden forever. But a slick, greenwashing corporate sponsor threatens to co-opt the whole movement, and winning will mean staying true to everything they believe while the world dangles every reason to sell out. As the final composting challenge comes down to the wire, two soulmates prove that the greenest, bravest, most sustainable thing you can ever do is refuse, again and again, to give up on love. A joyful, compost-warm conclusion.

series.title: Nothing Matters
series.author: Søren Blank
series.authorBio: Søren Blank writes from an unfurnished apartment because the furniture, like everything else, was ultimately meaningless. He is not sure why you are reading this. He is not sure why he wrote it. And yet, here we both are.
series.blurb: In a universe of cold, indifferent stars, two people who believe in absolutely nothing accidentally believe in each other.

books.title: The Void Between Us
books.description: Existential philosophy professor Jonas Krieg stared into the abyss for eleven years and felt precisely nothing; he had, he was certain, been cured of hope. Then Dr. Ilse Vandermeer sat down across from him at a departmental meeting so pointless it seemed to prove his entire worldview — and inexplicably, the abyss stared back with her eyes. She is a cosmologist who studies the heat death of the universe and finds it soothing; he has written four books arguing that human connection is an illusion. Trapped together on a doomed faculty committee to justify their department's existence to an indifferent dean, the two devoted nothing-believers accidentally, horrifyingly, begin to matter to each other. A darkly funny romance about meaning where there should be none.

books.title: Nothing to Lose
books.description: If existence is fundamentally meaningless, reasons perpetually deadpan barista-philosopher Agnes Vitt, then she may as well kiss the insufferable man who orders the same black coffee every morning and quotes Cioran at her before nine a.m. Lukas Brandt is a failed poet convinced the universe is indifferent — which is exactly why, when the two find themselves the only souls in an all-night diner during what may or may not be the end of the world, they resolve to do absolutely everything anyway. A road trip to nowhere in particular becomes a manifesto for loving, risking, and hoping precisely because none of it lasts. Bleakly hilarious and, against its own best efforts, unexpectedly life-affirming.

books.title: Amor Fati
books.description: "Love your fate," the philosophers said, and stonemason-turned-nihilist Viktor Sauer had always assumed his fate was to want nothing and get it. He never expected his fate to have such good forearms — or to belong to Delphine Roche, the relentlessly cheerful gravedigger who has made peace with mortality and finds his gloom, frankly, adorable. As the two work through a long summer of funerals in a dying mountain town, digging quite literally side by side, Viktor's carefully maintained despair keeps colliding with Delphine's radical acceptance of everything, himself included. When the town's last cemetery is slated to close, they must decide whether to fight for something they both believe is ultimately pointless. A wry, earthy romance about surrendering to the one thing you cannot reason away.

books.title: The Heat Death of the Heart
books.description: The finale. Entropy comes for all things — the stars, the diner, the department, and eventually Jonas and Ilse, now old and gray and still arguing gently about whether any of it meant anything at all. As the cosmos winds inexorably toward its final cold, and a quiet diagnosis forces them to confront their own approaching zero, the two lifelong nihilists take stock of a love that, by every principle they hold, should never have existed. It changes nothing about the fate of the universe. It changes everything about tonight. A quietly devastating, strangely comforting conclusion about finding warmth in the face of the inevitable dark. Bring nothing; you cannot take it with you. Also, bring tissues.

series.title: Magma Rising
series.author: Ignatia Cinders
series.authorBio: Ignatia Cinders has stood at the rim of more active calderas than she can count. She measures love, like lava, in viscosity and inevitability.
series.blurb: She reads the mountain's every tremor. He reads her. When the volcano finally blows, so does every ounce of restraint between them.

books.title: Pyroclastic
books.description: The evacuation order came at dawn; the confession came at the summit. Volcanologist Dr. Rhea Santos has spent three years monitoring Mount Kalderos, and she knows in her bones that today is the day it blows — a conviction her infuriating, by-the-book counterpart from the rival observatory, Dr. Mateo Vance, flatly refuses to sign off on. When the mountain proves her right and a pyroclastic flow comes screaming down the flank, the two are stranded above the evacuation line with one working vehicle and a confession that has been building longer than the eruption. A breathless, fast-moving romance you genuinely cannot outrun, about trusting your instincts when the ground itself is trying to kill you.

books.title: The Lava Tube
books.description: Trapped underground when the eruption begins hours early, rival geologists Priya Anand and Jack Halloran have only two failing headlamps, a rapidly warming lava tube, and the undeniable, inconvenient chemistry they have spent an entire field season denying. She thinks he is a reckless glory hound; he thinks she is a coward who hides behind her data — and now the only way out is a mapless crawl through a collapsing volcanic labyrinth as fresh magma advances behind them. In the dark, with the rock ticking as it cools and their air running thin, the walls between them melt faster than the basalt. A claustrophobic, molten, enemies-to-lovers pressure cooker.

books.title: Dormant No More
books.description: Seismologist Owen Fell had been quiet for years — a widower gone as still and cold as the extinct cinder cone he had retired to study. Then Dr. Selma Ríos arrived to recalibrate his ancient seismometer network and, in the process, recalibrated everything else. The mountain everyone declared dead begins, impossibly, to stir; and so, against every instinct, does Owen. As the tremors build and an old rival insists the swarm is nothing, Selma must convince a heartbroken man to believe in danger — and in second chances — before the reawakening buries them both. A slow-building, tender romance in four escalating parts, about the things that were never truly extinct, only sleeping.

books.title: Effusive
books.description: The finale. After a career of near-misses and one spectacular eruption survived together, Rhea and Mateo return to Mount Kalderos for its final, gentle effusive phase — the slow overflow of lava that follows the violence. But a mining consortium wants the mountain's flanks, an old professional betrayal claws its way back to the surface, and the two volcanologists must fight to protect the peak that made them, even as their own long-restrained love finally, unstoppably, overflows its banks. A warm, glowing, molten conclusion about what remains after the explosion — the slow, luminous flow that reshapes the entire landscape. Endorsed by no actual geological survey.

series.title: Bunker Down
series.author: Dakota Ridge
series.authorBio: Dakota Ridge has enough freeze-dried lasagna to outlast three civilizations and a bug-out plan for every letter of the alphabet. She wrote this series by hand-crank lamp, just in case.
series.blurb: When the world is ending — and to them, it is always ending — the only thing worth stockpiling is each other.

books.title: Bug-Out Bag
books.description: Prepper extraordinaire Sierra Kade has a laminated plan for every catastrophe from EMP to eruption — every catastrophe except Rhys Calloway, the maddeningly handsome stranger who rolls up her mountain driveway with a better bug-out rig, superior MREs, and intentions she cannot quite file under friend or threat. Is he a fellow survivor, a government plant, or a con man casing her stockpile? As a genuine regional emergency turns the drill real and the roads wash out beneath a hundred-year storm, Sierra is forced to shelter the one variable she never accounted for. Trust, it turns out, is the hardest thing to stockpile. A tense, funny, slow-burn romance about letting someone past the blast door.

books.title: Canned Goods
books.description: Fifteen years of shelf life, one very short fuse. When a false missile alert sends estranged prepper neighbors Dot Ferris and Milo Vance diving into the same two-person bunker — hers stocked to the ceiling, his empty because he always bet the apocalypse would never come — they are sealed in together for a mandatory seventy-two-hour all-clear wait. Seventy-two hours is a long time to ration beans, relitigate a decade-old feud, and pretend the cozy dark is not doing something to both of them. As the timer ticks down and the air recycler hums, two people who prepared for absolutely everything discover they are catastrophically unready for each other. Claustrophobic, cozy, and dangerously combustible.

books.title: Fallout
books.description: The sirens were only a drill. The feelings, unfortunately, were not. In the aftermath of a regional evacuation that turned out to be a false alarm, single father and reluctant prepper Elias Thorn is left to rebuild a homestead — and a heart — he was sure he had lost, with the unexpected help of Nadia Cole, the emergency-management officer who called the evacuation and now cannot seem to stop coming back to check on him. As the community rebuilds and buried resentments rise like groundwater, the two must figure out what is actually worth keeping when you thought you had lost it all. A tender, ash-and-rain-scented romance about salvage, forgiveness, and rebuilding on solid ground.

books.title: The All-Clear
books.description: The finale. The world, annoyingly, keeps refusing to end. After years of bracing for the apocalypse, Sierra and Rhys face the one scenario neither ever prepped for: an ordinary, open-ended future together, with no catastrophe to organize their love around. When a developer threatens the mountain community they have quietly built with their fellow survivors, the two must trade their bunker mentality for something far scarier — putting down roots, planning past the crisis, and betting on a tomorrow that might just keep on arriving. A warm, wry, deeply satisfying conclusion about the terrifying courage it takes to stop waiting for the end and start living.

series.title: Between the Flags
series.theme: Lifeguard romance, one body of water at a time
series.author: Sandy Shores
series.authorBio: Sandy Shores has guarded every kind of water there is — chlorinated, brackish, glacial, and artificially wave-generated. She has saved four hundred swimmers and, she'll admit, one or two hearts.
series.blurb: Different water, same rescue. Across pools, lakes, oceans, and one very aggressive wave machine, love keeps pulling people back to the surface.

books.title: The Deep End
books.description: Book one: the pool. Head guard Regina Salt runs the tightest municipal aquatic center in three counties — every whistle blast timed, every rule laminated, every lane a study in discipline. Then the city forces her to hire Dante Rivera, a former competitive diver with a suspended career, a devil-may-care grin, and a habit of diving straight past every regulation she holds sacred. Their war over deck protocol escalates from written warnings into something that steams up the humid air above the water, even as a budget crisis threatens to shutter the pool that is her entire life. When a real emergency puts a swimmer's life in both their hands, Regina learns that the strictest rules cannot govern the heart. Crisp, chlorinated, and sparkling with tension.

books.title: Still Waters
books.description: Book two: the lake. Beneath the deceptively calm surface of Camp Loon's summer waterfront, an old rivalry runs deep. Returning senior guard Frankie Doyle and the camp's golden-boy waterfront director, Wes Anders, once shared a dock and a summer that ended badly — and now they are forced to co-run the swim program for one final season before the beloved camp is sold off. As a hidden current pulls swimmers, and long-buried secrets, toward the surface, the two must navigate the undertow of everything left unsaid. When a camper goes missing on the water at dusk, still waters prove anything but calm. A slow, aching, sun-dappled romance about the depths beneath a placid surface.

books.title: Riptide
books.description: Book three: the ocean. On a treacherous, fog-bound stretch of the northern coast, burned-out veteran surf guard Marisol Reyes has stopped believing she can save anyone — least of all herself. Then fearless rookie Kai Brenner transfers in, all reckless courage and infuriating optimism, and starts swimming out past the breakers she will not touch. As a brutal storm season drives one dangerous rescue after another, the two clash over risk, mortality, and what it costs to keep dragging strangers back from the edge. But the strongest pull on that coast is not the riptide hauling swimmers out to sea — it is the one dragging two guarded hearts together. Salt-stung, high-stakes, and emotionally relentless.

books.title: The Wave Pool
books.description: The finale: the wave pool. At the grand opening of the world's largest indoor water park, veteran guard Dominic Vale takes a "safe," artificial posting to finally slow down — and collides, every ninety seconds on the dot, with Priya Sharma, the wave-machine engineer whose manufactured swells keep hurling them literally into each other's arms. It is all lazy rivers and fun until a mechanical failure turns the placid pool into a genuine disaster, and the two must trust each other to save hundreds of swimmers in water neither fully controls. A buoyant, splashy, surprisingly heartfelt conclusion proving that even artificial waves can carry two very real hearts home.

series.title: Not a Minute Late
series.author: Dot Sharpe
series.authorBio: Dot Sharpe has never been late to anything, including her own book launches, which begin at the stroke of the hour whether or not anyone has arrived. She finds tardiness unbearable and precision intoxicating.
series.blurb: For a rare few, nothing quickens the pulse like a train that departs exactly on time. This is a love story for people who arrive early — and finish on schedule.

books.title: On the Dot
books.description: For chronically punctual timetable-auditor Prudence Meade, nothing has ever quickened her pulse — until Julian Crane arrives for their first date exactly four minutes early, checks his pocket watch against the station clock, and nods with grave satisfaction. She nearly swoons on the platform. But Julian is the efficiency consultant hired to "optimize" the very rail network Prudence has devoted her life to keeping precisely on schedule, and his recommendations could dismantle the punctual world she loves. As the two circle each other through a series of impeccably timed rendezvous — never a minute early, never a minute late — Prudence must decide whether love can survive a difference of opinion measured in seconds. A slow-burn romance wound tight as a watch spring.

books.title: Synchronized
books.description: Two watches, one heartbeat. When rival horologists Adelaide Vance and Emmett Locke are commissioned to restore the same impossibly complex astronomical clock — she handling the celestial train, he the striking mechanism — their calendars align perfectly for the first time in their careers, and the tension becomes almost too much to schedule. Working in a cramped clock tower against a merciless deadline to have the great clock chiming by the town's centennial, every synchronized tick draws them closer and every missed beat drives them apart. But someone is sabotaging the mechanism, and the two sticklers must learn to keep time together before the whole thing grinds to a stop. A precise, ticking, deliciously wound romance about two people finally in sync.

books.title: Right on Time
books.description: The finale. At the grand reopening of the Greenwich Absolute — restored to be the most accurate public clock ever built — a lifetime of punctual devotion converges on a single, perfect moment. Prudence and Julian, reconciled and running the restoration together, face one last crisis when the great clock threatens to miss its ceremonial first chime before a watching world. As the second hand sweeps toward the appointed instant, two people who have spent their lives never being late discover that the very best moment to finally say "I love you" is, and always has been, precisely now. A satisfying, impeccably timed conclusion. Do not be late for the ending.

series.title: The Sweetest Sting
series.author: Melissa Comb
series.authorBio: Melissa Comb keeps forty hives and has been stung more times than she can count, though she maintains that none hurt quite like the first time she saw him in a veil.
series.blurb: Where the hum of the hive fills the summer air, two apiarists learn that the sweetest things in life are the ones worth a little sting.

books.title: Smoke & Honey
books.description: Master beekeeper Beatrix Hollis lost her prize queen — and half her strongest colony — the very same week that maddeningly serene newcomer Rowan Vale set up his hives on the adjoining farm. Coincidence? Her remaining bees seem to think not; they keep absconding across the property line to his wildflower meadows as though defecting. As Beatrix wages a quiet border war of smoke, swarm traps, and pointed neighborly notes, she and Rowan are forced together by a regional colony-collapse crisis threatening every hive in the valley. Amid the drowsy hum of a long golden summer, two rival keepers discover that some attractions, like a good queen, simply cannot be contained. Warm, buzzing, and sweet with a sting.

books.title: The Swarm
books.description: When a massive wild swarm — ten thousand bees strong — settles in the worst possible place, straddling the fence line between two feuding apiaries, longtime rivals Marlowe Finch and Cassius Doyle must suit up and work as one to capture it before the whole town panics. One tense, veil-to-veil afternoon of coordinated smoke and steady hands stretches into an entire season of reluctant partnership, as the captured swarm becomes a shared colony neither is willing to surrender. Suits come off eventually — metaphorically, and then, once, memorably not. But when the hive's fate is threatened by a developer's crop-spray plan, the two must decide whether their fragile truce can become something permanent. A funny, humming, enemies-to-lovers charmer.

books.title: Requeened
books.description: The finale. A heart long thought colony-collapsed finally finds its queen. As the richest honey harvest in the valley's history comes in golden and impossibly heavy, Beatrix and Rowan — partners now, in the apiary and in everything else — stake their combined life's work on saving a rare heritage bee line from extinction, with a ruthless commercial buyer and one hard early frost racing against them. Amid the frenzy of the harvest, old fears about whether either of them can truly be requeened, truly begin again, rise for one last reckoning. A lush, sun-warmed, deeply sweet conclusion about renewal, resilience, and the hive you build together. Notes of clover, wildflower, and hard-won forever.

series.title: Cooking the Books
series.author: Miles Ledger
series.authorBio: Miles Ledger, CPA, CFE, has traced more shell companies than he's had hot dinners. He maintains that a well-reconciled ledger is the most romantic document ever devised.
series.blurb: Where the numbers don't add up, two forensic accountants follow the money — straight into each other's arms.

books.title: Material Misstatement
books.description: Forensic accountant Vivian Cross flagged the discrepancy: a phantom twelve million dollars threaded through a shell company so elegant it was almost art. The problem is that the auditor who signed the original clean opinion is Adrian Wolfe — brilliant, infuriating, and the man she has quietly obsessed over since they clashed at a fraud-examiners conference two years ago. Locked in the same airless conference room to reconcile the impossible numbers before the SEC comes knocking, the two must decide whether Adrian is a fool, a co-conspirator, or the one person who can help her unravel it all. As the ledgers give up their secrets, so does everything they have each refused to confess. A taut, slow-burn romance that balances to the penny.

books.title: Off the Books
books.description: A midnight deposition. A missing four million dollars. And two forensic investigators who cannot, professionally or personally, stop crossing the lines they have sworn to hold. When by-the-book examiner Grace Okoye is partnered with off-the-books maverick Rafael Ortiz to trace a laundering operation through a dozen countries and one very suspicious yacht, their opposing methods collide in stakeouts, wire diagrams, and increasingly blurred boundaries. Every clue drags them deeper into danger — and closer together — until they are no longer sure whether they are building a case or a confession. As the trail leads somewhere neither expected, the two must decide what is worth risking their careers, and their hearts, to expose. Fully deductible passion, with receipts.

books.title: The Reconciliation
books.description: The finale. When the largest embezzlement case of the decade — the culmination of every thread, shell company, and stolen ledger from the entire series — finally goes to trial, Vivian and Adrian must present the case of their lives against the powerful figure who has been one step ahead all along. As the defense attacks their work, and their relationship becomes courtroom ammunition, the two forensic accountants discover that the hardest account to settle is the one between them. In the end everything — the fraud, the years, the love they nearly wrote off entirely — finally reconciles to the penny. A gripping, satisfying, perfectly balanced conclusion. All debits, at last, meet their credits.
